To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a special purpose architectural model of a large software system can be constructed and used to predict system properties accurately enough for it to be used as a tool in the design process.

1) the architecture of a large software system can be modeled by a Petri net, 2) the model can be analyzed using the Design /CPN tool, 3) the model is accurate enough to be used in architectural design, 4) the model is useful in the early stages of the product development process, 5) the model is a valuable tool in the configuration of product family members, and 6) the model is easy to maintain.
a special-purpose model can be constructed also for a large software system and that this model is useful for predicting system properties and for guiding architectural design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to model and analyze the execution architecture of software systems and how to use the results of such an analysis in software development.
the use of formal methods in industrial software development.
the development of methods and tools for architectural design and analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is an excellent tool for analyzing the execution architecture of a software system.
architectural modeling can be applied in the early stages of the software development process and that the models are useful for guiding design and analysis.
the model is useful and that we are able to analyze it with reasonable accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of Petri net models is a useful tool in software architecture development.
we have shown that it is possible to model and analyze large software systems with colored Petri net technology.
we can use the model to predict the performance of the software architecture of a product family and to analyze how changes in the software architecture influence performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
architectural modeling can be useful for industrial products.
the use of a modeling and analysis tool is a valuable aid in architectural design.
a special purpose architectural model can be constructed even for a large system and that it is useful in the early stages of design.
